note: POSIX only. Windows has no process groups or POSIX signals — see scripts/windows-spikes.mjs.

F1_spawnModes.question: Does detached:true actually give the child its own process group?

F3_parentOnlyKill.question: Does killing only the parent leave the grandchild running?

F3b_groupKill.question: Does a group kill reach the grandchild?

F4_escalation.question: Does SIGTERM→SIGKILL escalation actually fire for a child that traps SIGTERM?

F5_cancelExitCode.question: Can exit code distinguish a cancelled run from a successful one?
F5_cancelExitCode.conclusion: A child that handles its own signal exits 0 — identical to success. Exit code is not cancel evidence.

F6_zombieTrap.question: Does kill(pid,0) prove a process is running?
F6_zombieTrap.conclusion: no zombie observed in this run — the trap is documented in WBS-00-REPORT §2.8
